ruleDefinitions.name: Mstsc.EXE Execution From Uncommon Parent
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential RDP connection via Mstsc using a local ".rdp" file located in suspicious locations.

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\CCleanerBrowser\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\chromium\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\firefox\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\iexplore\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\microsoftedge\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\whale\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\outlook\\\.exe$")) AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\mstsc\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "mstsc\.exe"))
